title: Reset system metrics from the Overall System Aveva API page (Reset Metrics / A tag)
summary: When system metrics need to be cleared, you can manually reset them from the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page using the “Reset Metrics” control (speaker notes UPSHMI resets the metric when an “A tag” is hit). Metrics also reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded.
when_to_use: Use when you need to manually reset system metrics from the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page. The source also states metrics reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded, but this procedure provides the manual reset control on that page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the manual “Reset Metrics” action on the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page and verify whether metrics reset as expected.
access_or_tools_needed: UPSHMI access to the “Overall System Aveva API” page
On-screen controls: “Reset Metrics” and the “A tag” mentioned by the speaker

access_required: UPSHMI access to the “Overall System Aveva API” page

visual_references.description: Frame of the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page showing the “Reset Metrics” control and related controls (including the speaker note about hitting an “A tag”).

steps.title: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in the UPSHMI interface
steps.purpose: Access the page that contains the manual “Reset Metrics” control.
steps.instruction: In UPSHMI, navigate to the screen labeled “Overall System Aveva API”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is displayed with the “Reset Metrics” control visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The page shows the “Reset Metrics” control area along with other controls listed on the page (e.g., “Reset Tipper Stats”, “Get metrics”, “Get errors”).
steps.failure_condition: The “Overall System Aveva API” page does not load or the “Reset Metrics” control is not visible.

actions.label: Open Overall System Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in the UPSHMI interface.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “We also have reset metrics… you can do manually on this page… UPSHMI does it.”

steps.title: Locate the “Reset Metrics” control on the page
steps.purpose: Identify the exact control used to manually reset system metrics.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System Aveva API” page, find the “Reset Metrics” control.
steps.expected_result: You can point to the “Reset Metrics” control on the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.healthy_condition: The page text/controls include “Reset Metrics” and the related controls shown on the same page (e.g., “Reset Tipper Stats”, “Get metrics”, “Get errors”).
steps.failure_condition: “Reset Metrics” is not present on the displayed page view.

actions.label: Find Reset Metrics
actions.exact_action: Locate the “Reset Metrics” control on the page.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows: “Overall System Aveva API page … Reset Metrics … Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

steps.title: Manually reset metrics using the documented manual reset action (A tag / Reset Metrics)
steps.purpose: Trigger the manual metrics reset on UPSHMI.
steps.instruction: Use the manual reset action for “Reset Metrics” on the “Overall System Aveva API” page. The speaker notes UPSHMI resets the metric when an “A tag” is hit.
steps.expected_result: The manual reset action is executed for system metrics.
steps.healthy_condition: The reset action completes (no UI error is indicated on the page) and the metrics are ready to reflect the reset state.
steps.failure_condition: The reset action does not take effect (metrics do not change/reset after the action).

actions.label: Reset Metrics (A tag)
actions.exact_action: They hit A tag and it resets the metric.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the metrics do not reset after using the documented manual reset action, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “They hit A tag and it resets the metric.” and “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

steps.title: Confirm the metrics have been reset
steps.purpose: Verify that the manual reset produced the expected metrics reset behavior.
steps.instruction: After triggering “Reset Metrics”, confirm that the system metrics reflect the reset state (the source states metrics reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded and can also be manually reset from this page).
steps.expected_result: System metrics show the reset result after the manual action.
steps.healthy_condition: Metrics reflect a reset state consistent with the source behavior (i.e., the metrics are cleared/reset rather than remaining unchanged).
steps.failure_condition: Metrics do not reset/clear after the manual reset action.

actions.label: Verify metrics reset
actions.exact_action: Confirm the metrics have been reset.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the metrics do not reset after using the documented manual reset action, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.
Do not rely on this action to fix underlying errors if “Get errors” indicates active issues.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.” and page includes “Get errors” pop-up control.

success_criteria: After using the “Reset Metrics” manual action (A tag), the system metrics reflect a reset state on the UPSHMI “Overall System Aveva API” page.
healthy_conditions: Metrics change to reflect the reset state after the manual reset action.
If active issues exist, “Get errors” indicates them; the reset action is not treated as a fix for underlying errors.
failure_conditions: Metrics do not reset after triggering the manual “Reset Metrics” action.
“Get errors” indicates active issues and metrics reset is attempted as a substitute for addressing those errors.
escalation_guidance: If metrics do not reset after using the documented manual reset action, stop and escalate to support for deeper investigation.

screens_or_images.description: Overall System Aveva API page frame showing “Reset Metrics” and related controls; includes the speaker note about hitting an “A tag” to reset the metric.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: “We also have reset metrics… you can do manually on this page… UPSHMI does it. They hit A tag and it resets the metric.” OCR: “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

missing_details: The source does not explicitly name the exact on-screen label/location for the “A tag” beyond the speaker note; the runbook uses the “Reset Metrics” control as the manual reset action.
